definition: Singles-only shadow baseline: bet the side whenever the model's fair spread differs from the market spread by >= 1.5 points
evaluation_window: 2026 Week 12 through Week 18 (7 weeks, prospective only)
supporting_evidence: model side edge exists beyond the market (MLB-style market inefficiency in low-information weeks)
refuting_evidence: market closing line out-predicts the model on the same fixtures (CLV <= 0)

definition: Home underdog of +7 or more, model total disagrees with market total by >= 3 points, side taken on the total
supporting_evidence: public bias inflates favourites and suppresses home dogs' totals
refuting_evidence: the residual is fully explained by injuries already priced by the market

definition: Rest/bye asymmetry: the club coming off a bye is bet when the model margin exceeds the market by >= 2
supporting_evidence: bye-week preparation value is under-priced in the opening number
refuting_evidence: no bye-club edge survives once the opening line is removed

definition: Two-leg cross-game parlay priced only from a directly validated joint probability
supporting_evidence: cross-game legs are close to independent (correlations.csv n=136)
refuting_evidence: a measured positive leg correlation makes the product of marginals optimistic

definition: Same-game legs (QB yards with a receiver's yards)
supporting_evidence: same-game legs share a driver, so the joint probability can exceed the product
refuting_evidence: no official prop feed exists, so the joint cannot be validated at all

definition: Two-player prop combination from official box scores only
supporting_evidence: usage concentration makes some pairs predictable
refuting_evidence: no licensed prop market exists to price against, so no combo can be originated
